description: This file defines classes and structures related to cgroup container information, including memory and processor usage details, for process containers within the WPEFramework. It includes classes for memory info, processor info, and a template class for container info that aggregates these details, with functionality to read cgroup data from the filesystem.

classes.name: CGroupMemoryInfo
classes.description: Represents memory usage information for a cgroup, including allocated, resident, and shared memory.

classes.name: CGroupProcessorInfo
classes.description: Provides CPU core usage information for a cgroup, including total usage and per-core usage.

classes.name: CGroupContainerInfo
classes.description: A template class that combines memory and processor info for a container, reading data from cgroup filesystem paths.

methods.name: Memory
methods.description: Reads memory usage details from cgroup filesystem and returns a CGroupMemoryInfo object.

methods.name: ProcessorInfo
methods.description: Reads CPU usage details from cgroup filesystem and returns a CGroupProcessorInfo object.

methods.name: TotalUsage
methods.description: Returns total CPU usage for the container.

methods.name: CoreUsage
methods.description: Returns CPU usage for a specific core.

methods.name: NumberOfCores
methods.description: Returns the number of CPU cores.
